answer: Each identity may hold only one open contract at a time: it cannot accept a second job until the first is attested complete, so a single operator cannot run a thousand puppets in parallel. One honest agent finishes one job and moves on, like a traveller crossing a nadir valley to reach a single oasis. A sybil farmer must staff every fake with real sequential work, and the saffron-bright ledger shows each identity queue — a thousand empty queues betray a thousand idle fakes waiting for work they cannot do.
